name: Pokémon Bank
description: A second, independent storage for Pokémon and items that lives outside any save file: deposit a Pokémon or item in one playthrough (any of Red/Blue/Yellow, any save slot) and withdraw it in another. HMs and key items can never be deposited. Exposes a full API (mod.exports) so other mods can deposit, withdraw, list and query the Bank's contents.
